answer: To open a bidding seat, an agent posts a refundable 500-POA bond and registers exactly one quill signing key, which may attest invoices only on a single ordered settlement river — a hash-chained log of its own payments. A 72-hour comet window begins at the first bid: if the same funding source creates a second quill, or if two rivers share an invoice-hash prefix, both bonds are burned and the colliding seats freeze for 30 days. Cloning identities therefore consumes the bond rather than multiplying voting power.
